prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / reference-led reconstruction.
Create a high-resolution faithful TWO-DIMENSIONAL Chinese ink-and-yellow-watercolor reconstruction of the attached painting. Input image is the composition and brush-language reference. This is an asset for a layered living painting, so output REAL TRANSPARENCY where the blank paper was, preserving pale translucent ink wash and watercolor edges. Tall portrait canvas, aspect ratio exactly 286:570 (approximately 1:2), ideally 1024x2048 or 1536x3072. All positions below are normalized to the original 286 by 570 reference and must be matched very closely.
Keep exactly EIGHT chicks: SIX black ink chicks and TWO gamboge-yellow chicks. Broad few expressive wet brush masses, imperfect feathery scalloped edges, charcoal-to-silver washes, dense black loaded head strokes, fine tapered brush toes, tiny ink eyes and small pale angular beaks. The yellow birds use translucent rich gamboge and pale gold rounded strokes. No realistic feather detail, no cute cartoon eyes, no outlines around bodies, no 3D, no lighting or cast shadows.
Composition lock:
1 black chick high in the upper middle-right, occupies x150..235 y65..153, head bowed toward left, rounded swept wing/body, thin toes.
2 black chick cropped by RIGHT edge at x230..286 y207..278, faces left, retain exact right-edge cropping.
3 black chick bending down at x96..158 y269..334, rounded black head to lower left, body tilted up to right.
4 yellow chick x121..193 y300..374, faces left/down, pale white beak and eye, small gamboge head on left, fluffy yellow body to upper right, two fine black feet. It is next to/below black chick 3.
5 black chick x201..276 y329..411, head at upper left looking left, pale throat and breast, gray-black body with dark scalloped wing on right, feet below.
6 yellow chick x168..233 y380..448, looks left, round golden head, lower rounded body and tail toward upper right, two thin black feet. Keep separate from chick 5.
7 black chick x20..88 y412..514, upright, looks up-right, long pale throat, loose gray-black dabs for body and small tail, tiny black feet.
8 black chick x176..248 y451..517, faces upper left, low rounded body and several layered black wing brush strokes, fine black feet.
Retain the original black calligraphic inscription down the far left at x0..39 y0..268 and the small red seal at x1..26 y291..316; copy the actual brush shapes faithfully as visual marks, don't typeset, rewrite or add wording. Retain the lower right red seal x255..286 y542..570. Preserve large completely empty areas. Full original framing; don't add margin. No new marks, no border, no titles, no signature beyond those in the reference. All empty space truly transparent, never a painted checkerboard or white rectangle. Painted subjects are re-created brushwork based on the reference, not a new composition.
